svg.title: BugSigDB LinkML data model
svg.desc: Study contains Experiments, each Experiment contains Signatures, each Signature lists Taxa. Study, Experiment and Signature mix in CurationProvenance, which links to Review records. Condition, body site, host species and taxa are bound to EFO, UBERON and NCBI Taxonomy.
svg.text: 6 classes · 64 slots · 12 enums. Every slot is shown, one card per class; related slots (group fields, alpha diversity) share a row.
Mixed into Study, Experiment and Signature.
Slot names with {…} or · stand for several slots.
Slot notation: * required · [] multivalued · ◆ identifier. Type colour: violet = enum, amber = ontology / NCBI-bound, green = class reference.
